title: Burnt x Saint's Dragons Compat
description: Adds compatibility between Burnt Basic and Saint's Dragons Volitans Water Breath!
body:
# Burnt x Saints Dragons Compat
This mod adds compatibility between [Burnt Basic](https://modrinth.com/project/aclfPzta) and [Saint's Dragons](https://modrinth.com/project/rjcsjwEU).

## Fixes:
- Volitans Water Breath now extinguishes modded (Burnt) fire!

### Thank you to [pxlbnk](https://modrinth.com/user/fxWOhc5t) for the [Burnt Basic Mod](https://modrinth.com/project/aclfPzta), and [SaintVanWinkle](https://modrinth.com/user/Lj3MvA8x) for the [Saint's Dragons Mod](https://modrinth.com/project/rjcsjwEU)!

This is an unofficial compatibility addon and is not endorsed by either mod authors.
